thread:
Maya L.: Hi all — new hire here, trying to reach some internal services during onboarding. I can SSH to the bastion but when I try `curl http://api.redwood.internal/health` I get DNS error. I didn't enable full tunnel (want to avoid routing all traffic). Anyone seen this with split-tunnel VPN? Who should I ping?
Sam I.: hey Maya, welcome! sounds like the VPN isn't pushing our internal DNS suffix. quick check: can you `ping` the bastion by IP and by name? e.g. `ping 10.12.3.7` and `ping bastion.redwood.internal`
Maya L.: ping by IP works to 10.12.3.7, ping bastion.redwood.internal fails with "unknown host".
Michael (infra-oncall): likely the split-tunnel profile isn't providing the DNS search/suffix. On mac you can also check `scutil --dns` to see what resolvers are configured. If you prefer, we can add a host entry temporarily.
Maya L.: I ran `scutil --dns` — it shows only my home ISP DNS. I'm on macOS Ventura. Not sure how to change the VPN client settings.
Sam I.: ah ok. Two quick options: 1) we can push the internal DNS to your client (requires a small change on our VPN config, I'll coordinate), or 2) add a temporary /etc/hosts entry mapping api.redwood.internal -> 10.12.5.42 while you finish onboarding. Which do you prefer?
Maya L.: temporary hosts is fine if you tell me the format. Also want to avoid messing up my laptop config long-term.
Jen R.: for hosts approach, add a single line to `/etc/hosts` (requires sudo):
```
10.12.5.42 api.redwood.internal
```
That should let curl hit the service. Remember to remove it after we confirm the VPN fix.
Maya L.: thanks. tried that, curl now returns HTML but `docker login registry.internal.redwood` still times out. registry is on a different subnet I think.
Michael (infra-oncall): registry is only accessible via the bastion or from inside the VPC. Two options: SSH local port forward, or we can open an ephemeral jumpproxy for your IP. For port-forward: run:
```
ssh -L 5000:registry.internal.redwood:5000 maya@bastion.redwood.internal -N
```
then `docker login localhost:5000` in another terminal.
Maya L.: ok trying the ssh command now...
deploy-bot: (system) bastion session for maya started, audit id: d3f4b
Maya L.: forwarding worked, was able to `docker login` and pull onboarding image :rocket:
Sam I.: I'll follow up with infra team to add the DNS search suffix to the split-tunnel profile so you don't need hosts entries. @Michael can you add Maya's laptop to the jump-host allowlist for the remainder of the week?
Michael (infra-oncall): done — added the public key from her onboarding ticket and whitelisted current IP for 7d. Also filed ticket INF-4123 to update the VPN profile.
Maya L.: fantastic, thanks everyone. Last Q — after editing /etc/hosts on mac do I need to flush DNS cache?
Jen R.: yes run `sudo dscacheutil -flushcache; sudo killall -HUP mDNSResponder` once, then retry curl.
Maya L.: flushed, everything still good. big thanks, this unblocked my setup. :thumbsup:
